title: An empty change directory left by a branch switch counts as an open native change
symptom: knowledge/INDEX.md lists a change as active although its branch is not checked out, so library index --check fails in a fresh clone of the same commit
trigger: Switch from a branch with an open SpecSync change to one without it: Git removes the tracked files but leaves the empty .specsync/changes/<id>/deltas/ directory; then run chough library index
expected: A directory under .specsync/changes/ with no change files is not an open change: the index, the open-change refusal of library archive --apply and every other reader skip it
actual: chough library index lists the empty directory under Active, and the committed index differs from what a fresh clone generates (knowledge step of the verify lane failed on Linux at 2daa96b2)
steps: On claude/test/c6-nine-criteria-assertions (open change give-real-...-138), run git checkout claude/test/c5-eight-validity-readers
chough library index: knowledge/INDEX.md Active lists give-real-...-138; a fresh clone of the same commit generates no such line
impact: A branch-switching agent commits an index that CI's knowledge check rejects; library archive --apply may refuse with a false open change
